universalRules:
NEVER use HTML tags (
, , etc.) - Mermaid does not support HTML
Use pure text only - create new lines by adding separate entries
Avoid special characters that may break parsing

flowchart.whenToUse: Process flows, decision trees, algorithm visualization, system architecture
flowchart.minimalTemplate:
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Action 1]
    B -->|No| D[Action 2]
commonErrors: Using graph instead of flowchart keyword

graph.whenToUse: Simple directed/undirected graphs, alternative to flowchart

sequenceDiagram.whenToUse: API interactions, message flows, communication protocols, service calls
sequenceDiagram.minimalTemplate:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Client
    participant B as Server
    A->>B: Request
    B-->>A: Response

classDiagram.whenToUse: OOP class structures, database schemas, type definitions

stateDiagram.whenToUse: State machines, workflow states, lifecycle diagrams
stateDiagram.minimalTemplate:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Processing: Start
    Processing --> Complete: Finish
    Complete --> [*]
commonErrors: Using v1 syntax instead of v2

erDiagram.whenToUse: Database entity relationships, data models, schema visualization

journey.whenToUse: User journeys, customer experience maps, process timelines
journey.minimalTemplate:
journey
    title User Journey
    section Login
        Visit site: 5: User
        Enter credentials: 3: User
        Click login: 5: User

gantt.whenToUse: Project timelines, task schedules, milestone tracking
gantt.minimalTemplate:
gantt
    title Project Schedule
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Phase 1
        Task A: 2024-01-01, 7d
        Task B: after Task A, 5d

pie.whenToUse: Simple pie charts, percentage distributions, categorical breakdowns
pie.minimalTemplate:
pie title Distribution
    "Category A": 40
    "Category B": 35
    "Category C": 25

mindmap.minimalTemplate:
mindmap
  root((Central Idea))
    Branch 1
      Sub-branch 1a
      Sub-branch 1b
    Branch 2
      Sub-branch 2a

timeline.whenToUse: Historical events, project milestones, chronological sequences
timeline.minimalTemplate:
timeline
    title Project History
    section Phase 1
        2024-01 : Kickoff
        2024-02 : Development
    section Phase 2
        2024-03 : Launch
commonErrors: Not using colon separator between time and event
Putting multiple items on one line instead of separate entries

gitGraph.whenToUse: Git workflows, branch strategies, version control visualization
gitGraph.minimalTemplate:
gitGraph
    commit
    branch feature
    checkout feature
    commit
    checkout main
    merge feature

quadrantChart.minimalTemplate:
quadrantChart
    title Analysis Matrix
    x-axis Low --> High
    y-axis Low --> High
    quadrant-1 Q1
    quadrant-2 Q2
    quadrant-3 Q3
    quadrant-4 Q4
    Item A: [0.8, 0.7]

requirementDiagram.whenToUse: Requirements engineering, SysML diagrams, system requirements

kanban.whenToUse: Task boards, work queues, agile workflows

sankey-beta.whenToUse: Flow diagrams, resource allocation, data pipeline visualization

xychart-beta.whenToUse: Simple bar/line charts within Mermaid context
xychart-beta.minimalTemplate:
xychart-beta
    title "Sales Chart"
    x-axis [Jan, Feb, Mar]
    y-axis "Revenue" 0 --> 100
    bar [50, 75, 60]

block-beta.whenToUse: Block diagrams, system architecture, component layouts
block-beta.minimalTemplate:
block-beta
    columns 3
    A: "Block A"
    B: "Block B"
    C: "Block C"
    A --> B

architecture-beta.whenToUse: Cloud architecture, infrastructure diagrams, system topology
architecture-beta.minimalTemplate:
architecture-beta
    service api(database)[API Gateway]
    service db(disk)[Database]
    api:R --> L:db
